id: 6c4e9d21-7a58-4b3f-9d21-1f8c3a5e7b04
status: experimental
description: Detects creation of a .php/.phtml/.php5/.phar file under wp-content, wp-admin or wp-includes by a web worker process, indicative of web shell persistence after the wp2shell pre-auth RCE (CVE-2026-63030).
references:
  - https://www.aikido.dev/blog/unauthenticated-rce-in-wordpress-wp2shell
  - https://slcyber.io/research-center/wp2shell-pre-authentication-rce-in-wordpress-core/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/07/18
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1505.003
logsource:
  category: file_event
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/httpd'
      - '/apache2'
      - '/nginx'
      - '/php-fpm'
      - '\w3wp.exe'
      - '\php-cgi.exe'
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '/wp-content/'
      - '/wp-admin/'
      - '/wp-includes/'
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '.php'
      - '.phtml'
      - '.php5'
      - '.phar'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - WordPress core/plugin/theme auto-updates writing PHP files during a maintenance window
  - Legitimate plugin installs performed via the admin UI
level: high
2795.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.action="created" AND (Filesystem.file_path="*/wp-content/*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/wp-admin/*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/wp-includes/*") AND (Filesystem.file_name="*.php" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.phtml" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.php5" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.php7" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.phar")) by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name, Filesystem.action
| `drop_dm_object_name("Filesystem")`
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| sort - lastTime
2795.datadog: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 @Image:(*\\w3wp.exe OR *\\W3WP.exe OR *\\php-cgi.exe OR *\\PHP-CGI.exe) @TargetFilename:(*\\wp-content\\* OR *\\wp-admin\\* OR *\\wp-includes\\*) @TargetFilename:(*.php OR *.phtml OR *.php5 OR *.phar)

let win = 15m;
let filedisc = Syslog
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
  | where SyslogMessage has 'xz' and SyslogMessage has_any ('/etc/shadow','id_rsa','.pem','.key','/etc/ssh/')
  | project T1 = TimeGenerated, Computer, Stage1 = 'xz_file_read', Msg1 = SyslogMessage;

2850.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — Unpacking the AsyncAPI npm supply chain compromise and import-time payload deliv
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("node.js", "sync.js", "index.js") or FolderPath has_any ("%LOCALAPPDATA%\NodeJS\sync.js"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("%LOCALAPPDATA%\NodeJS\sync.js", "/Library/Application") or FileName in~ ("node.js", "sync.js", "index.js"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
2850.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — Unpacking the AsyncAPI npm supply chain compromise and import-time payload deliv ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("node.js","sync.js","index.js") OR Processes.process_path="*%LOCALAPPDATA%\NodeJS\sync.js*")
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_path="*%LOCALAPPDATA%\NodeJS\sync.js*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/Library/Application*" OR Filesystem.file_name IN ("node.js","sync.js","index.js"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

let bunUrlIndicators = dynamic(["github.com/oven-sh/bun", "oven-sh/bun/releases", "bun-windows-x64", "bun-linux-x64", "bun-darwin"]);
let npmParents = dynamic(["npm.exe","npm-cli.js","node.exe","yarn.exe","pnpm.exe","npx.exe"]);
let downloaderChildren = dynamic(["node.exe","curl.exe","powershell.exe","wget.exe","bun.exe","bash.exe","sh.exe","pwsh.exe"]);
// Process-tree pivot — npm parent spawning a downloader child with Bun URL on the command line
let ProcHits = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(14d)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (npmParents) or InitiatingProcessParentFileName in~ (npmParents)
    | where FileName in~ (downloaderChildren)
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (bunUrlIndicators) or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any (bunUrlIndicators)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
              InitImage  = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InitCmd    = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildImage = FileName,
              ChildCmd   = ProcessCommandLine, SHA256;
// Network pivot — same process families connecting to github.com for the Bun release tarball
let NetHits = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(14d)
    | where RemoteUrl has "github.com" and (RemoteUrl has "oven-sh/bun" or RemoteUrl has "bun-windows" or RemoteUrl has "bun-linux" or RemoteUrl has "bun-darwin")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (downloaderChildren)
    | where InitiatingProcessParentFileName in~ (npmParents) or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any (npmParents)
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName,
              AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
              InitImage   = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InitCmd     = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildImage  = "<network-egress>", ChildCmd = RemoteUrl, SHA256 = InitiatingProcessSHA256;
union ProcHits, NetHits
| order by Timestamp desc

let loginIPs = AppServiceHTTPLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where CsMethod == "POST" and CsUriStem has "login"   // Kimai/Symfony form-login check route
    | distinct CIp;
AppServiceHTTPLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where CsUriStem has_any ("/admin/", "/api/", "/user")   // authenticated Kimai surfaces
| where ScStatus >= 200 and ScStatus < 400
| where CsUsername != "" or Cookie has "KIMAI_REMEMBER"    // session was authenticated
| where CIp !in (loginIPs)                                 // but no form login ever seen from this IP
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Requests = count(), Paths = make_set(CsUriStem, 20) by CIp, UserAgent, CsUsername
| order by FirstSeen desc
2922.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Web where (Web.url="*/en/admin/*" OR Web.url="*/api/*" OR Web.url="*/en/users*" OR Web.url="*/en/user/*") Web.status>=200 Web.status<400 by Web.src, Web.http_user_agent, Web.url, Web.status
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| search NOT [ | tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Web where Web.http_method=POST Web.url="*login*" by Web.src | `drop_dm_object_name(Web)` | fields src ]
| stats min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime sum(count) as requests values(url) as urls by src, http_user_agent
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| sort - lastTime

2945.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — jscrambler npm package publishes malicious preinstall binary
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("mutations.js", "queries.js", "iphlpapi.dll", "setup.js"))

2945.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — jscrambler npm package publishes malicious preinstall binary ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("mutations.js","queries.js","iphlpapi.dll","setup.js"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path

| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`

| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path

tags:

logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  parent:
    ParentImage|re: '(?i)(php-fpm|php-cgi|/php$|httpd|apache2|nginx|/sh$|/bash$|/dash$)'
  child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/cat'
      - '/head'
      - '/grep'
      - '/curl'
      - '/base64'
      - '/xxd'
  target:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'wakka.config'
      - '.env'
      - '/etc/passwd'
      - '/etc/shadow'
  condition: parent and child and target
level: high
2995.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("php-fpm","php-fpm7.4","php-fpm8.0","php-fpm8.1","php-fpm8.2","php-fpm8.3","httpd","apache2","nginx","php","sh","bash","dash") Processes.process_name IN ("cat","head","tail","less","more","grep","curl","base64","xxd","od","awk")) by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_name, Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | search process="*wakka.config*" OR process="*.env*" OR process="*/etc/passwd*" OR process="*/etc/shadow*" | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime

2996.sent:
// Requires PHP-FPM / Apache error logs shipped to Syslog on the YesWiki host.
let Lookback = 7d;
Syslog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
| where SyslogMessage has "CalcField"
| where SyslogMessage has_any ("PHP Parse error","syntax error","PHP Fatal error","Uncaught Error","undefined function","Call to undefined function")
| summarize FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated), Hits=count(), Sample=any(SyslogMessage) by Computer, ProcessName
| order by Hits desc
2996.spl: index=* sourcetype IN ("php:error","apache:error","php_fpm") ("CalcField.php" OR "CalcField") ("PHP Parse error" OR "syntax error" OR "PHP Fatal error" OR "Uncaught Error" OR "undefined function" OR "Call to undefined function") | stats count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(_raw) as sample by host | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
2996.datadog: source:linux.syslog (@log.file.path:*CalcField* OR CalcField) ("PHP Parse error" OR "syntax error" OR "PHP Fatal error" OR "undefined function")

2997.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — [GHSA / CRITICAL] CVE-2026-52777: YesWiki Vulnerable to Authenticated PHP Object
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("import.js"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FileName in~ ("import.js"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
2997.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — [GHSA / CRITICAL] CVE-2026-52777: YesWiki Vulnerable to Authenticated PHP Object ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("import.js"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_name IN ("import.js"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]
